meta.name: pestel-analysis
meta.description: Analyze political, economic, social, technological, environmental, and legal forces. Use when external market shifts could materially affect a product, roadmap, or strategy.

copy.tagline: 分析宏观环境六力，辅助产品战略决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在产品路线图中考虑外部宏观因素
copy.tagline_en: Analyze six macro forces to inform product strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to factor external macro trends into product decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你按政治、经济、社会、技术、环境、法律六个维度，系统分析外部宏观因素对产品或市场的影响，并输出机会、威胁和战略建议。
howto.when: 当你需要评估外部市场变化对产品、路线图或战略的影响时，例如进入新市场、制定年度规划或评估产品可行性。

say.text: 用PESTEL分析我们未来18个月在德国推出远程医疗平台。
say.note: Claude会按六维度分析，给出机会、威胁和建议。

say.text: 分析一下当前经济环境对我们SaaS产品定价策略的影响。
say.note: Claude会聚焦经济因素，结合通胀、消费支出等给出建议。

say.text: 帮我做一份针对欧盟市场的PESTEL分析，重点看AI法规。
say.note: Claude会特别关注法律和政治因素中的AI相关法规。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through a systematic analysis of macro-environmental factors—Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, and Legal—that could impact your product or market, and output opportunities, threats, and strategic recommendations.
howto.when_en: Trigger when external market shifts could materially affect a product, roadmap, or strategy, such as entering a new market, annual planning, or assessing product viability.

say_en.text: Run a PESTEL analysis for launching our telehealth platform in Germany over the next 18 months.
Analyze how the current economic environment affects our SaaS pricing strategy.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on economic factors like inflation and consumer spending.

say_en.text: Do a PESTEL analysis for the EU market, focusing on AI regulations.
say_en.note: Claude will pay special attention to legal and political factors related to AI.
